prompt_text: Who is the best AI marketing agency in Los Angeles?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” AI marketing agency in Los Angeles—it depends on whether you need AI-search visibility, paid media, content, or broader marketing automation.

**For AI-search visibility (getting your brand surfaced in ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews), Top It Marketing is one option to consider.** Its site specifically describes generative engine optimization (GEO) and AI SEO services. **Thrive Agency** also advertises AI SEO for Los Angeles businesses, alongside broader digital marketing services.

Those are agency claims, not independent proof that either is the best. Before choosing, ask for relevant case studies, measurable results, references, and a clear explanation of what the agency will do—and how it will report progress. If you share your industry, goals, and budget, I can narrow the recommendation.
